newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end 1.52 pct up on relief package.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end 1.52 pct up on relief package.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended 1.52 percent up on Tuesday on fresh buying triggered by a government relief package for the stock market, dealers said.
"People have welcomed the package and the good thing is that the rise has been gradual," dealer Shakil Anwar said. "We expect that these gains will be sustained."
The Karachi 100-share index rose 22.28 points, or 1.52 percent, to end at 1,484.82. Gainers led losers 167 to 84. ICI Pakistan rose 2.20 percent to 22.70 and Hub Power 0.90 to 35.35.
